title: listbox vs dropdown
rule: Dropdown to downplay alternatives / keep a default; listbox to expose options and encourage change.
pass_when: Dropdown is used to keep a default / downplay alternatives; listbox is used when options should stay visible and change is encouraged.
fail_when: Listbox hides alternatives that should stay visible, or a dropdown is used when the design needs to encourage changing the default.
overview: Dropdown keeps a default; listbox exposes options and encourages change.
apply_when: Choosing between dropdown to downplay and listbox to expose options.
not_when: Hiding options that should stay visible or discouraging needed default changes.
agent_hint: Use dropdown to keep defaults; use listbox when options should stay visible.
description: Use a dropdown to downplay alternatives and keep a default; use a listbox when options should stay visible and change is encouraged. Pass when dropdown keeps the default or downplays alternatives, and listbox exposes options to encourage change. Fail when a listbox hides alternatives that should stay visible, or a dropdown is used when the design needs to encourage changing the default.
